prompt:
Pixel art sprite of the zodiac sign ARIES: a ram's head, front view, roaring, big curled horns, centred inside a thin-lined hexagon frame with a sunburst of flames behind it. Character: bold, fiery, impatient.

Style: 16-bit console pixel art, hard square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, no dithering. Drawn on a 120 x 120 pixel grid, shown enlarged so each pixel is a clear square. Flat solid black background.

Palette: exactly four colours plus black: cream, deep red, orange, dark blue. Each colour may appear in up to three flat shades, nothing else.

Composition: symmetrical, the subject fills about 60% of the frame, eyes, mouth and other features drawn as clearly separate shapes with a dark outline between them. Square image, no text, no letters, no border, no watermark, no signature.
